name: nGZCommandParser::ThrowUnless (throw-if-clear helper, __cdecl varargs)
notes: Hooked (not run in-game). No-op when the low byte of the first argument is nonzero (flags 0x100 and 0x12345600 throw, 0x01000001 does not); otherwise formats into 0x10f6bc8 and throws a cError built from that text used as a format string (ORIGINAL-BUG reproduced, including the stale stack words it reads: buffer address, 0x800, the format pointer, and the half-built object words). What is thrown is read from the SEH exception record: object, type names and sizes (.?AVcError@nGZCommandParser@@:1c and .?AVcIGZExceptionBase@@:4, same as the original). Mutants killed: inverted condition, truncated first format, each stale word, wrong buffer. Conversions that read the fourth stale word (the argument pointer, a stack address) are not tested. The one surviving mutant (testing `ok & 1`) is equivalent: ok is a bool, which the compiler reads as 0 or 1.
